# animation

<!-- Generated by catalog:generate; do not edit. -->

[中文](animation.zh.md)

Choose entry/exit presets for framework append/show and animated hide/removal. Use `animation.flipchild` on the parent for moving siblings, and `animation.intersectionBlocker` to gate first appearance. Popups own their show/hide configuration.

## Common animation args

Entry and exit presets share the base arguments below. These are the `fadein` defaults; each entry shows its additions and overrides, including direction and timing differences. `beforeApply` receives `(el, args)` and replacing it also replaces any preset preparation. `genie` uses `triggerSelector` to determine its origin.

Positional order: `duration` → `easing` → `delay` → `fill` → `origin` → `triggerSelector` → `beforeApply` → `direction`.

| Argument | Type | Default | Contract |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `duration` | `numberOrString` | `200` | Duration<br>Unit: `ms` |
| `easing` | `string` | `ease-in-out` | Easing<br>Options: `linear`, `ease`, `easeIn`, `easeOut`, `easeInOut`, `boing`, `urging`, `bouncing`, `decelerate`, `accelerate`, `smooth`, `sine`, `sineIn`, `sineOut`, `sineInOut`, `crisp`, `overshoot`, `runup`, `quartOut`, `velvet`, `gear`, `plateau` |
| `delay` | `numberOrString` | `0` | Delay<br>Unit: `ms` |
| `fill` | `string` | `backwards` | Fill mode<br>Options: `backwards`, `forwards`, `both`, `none` |
| `origin` | `string` | Not supplied | Origin |
| `triggerSelector` | `string` | Not supplied | Trigger selector |
| `beforeApply` | `function` | Not supplied | Callback before applying<br>Receives (el, args). Replacing it also replaces variant preparation for scale and origin. |
| `direction` | `string` | `normal` | Direction |

## `delay` and `duration` helpers

Preset `delay` and `duration` accept milliseconds or computed timing expressions. FLIP delay also supports sequences measured from the captured reference child.

| Helper | Description | Defaults and limits |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `seq(per, offset, limit)` | `offset + index * per` milliseconds, using `--jam-anima-idx` | `per: 40`, `offset: 0`. Optional `limit` caps increasing sequences or floors decreasing sequences; zero `per` ignores the limit. |
| `random(min, max)` | Random milliseconds between the supplied bounds | `min: 0`, `max: min + 100`. Thus `random()` uses 0–100 and `random(25)` uses 25–125. |

```javascript
Styles.animation.entry.fromleft({ delay: 'seq(50, 100)' });
Styles.animation.entry.frombottom({ delay: 'random(0, 400)' });
```

## Generic animation

### `animation`

<a id="entry-animation"></a>

Animation

Play caller-supplied keyframes on an element.

Starts a Web Animations API animation when the host mounts, using the supplied keyframes and timing/composition options.

Provide valid Web Animations keyframes and a host supporting Element.animate.

Mount creates the animation. Unmount, style teardown or host destruction cancels the stored animation for that setup; a later mount can create a fresh animation while the style remains installed.

Use for custom keyframes. Use animation.entry and animation.exit presets for framework append/show and remove/hide transitions.

The generic adapter currently forwards its CSS-unit delay (including the default 0ms) to Element.animate, which requires numeric delay. Use the native keyframe example with explicit cancellation until that adapter is corrected. Presets use the CSS animation path.

Positional order: `duration` → `delay` → `easing` → `fill` → `composite` → `direction` → `iterations` → `keyframes`.

| Argument | Type | Default | Contract |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `duration` | `number` | `200` | Duration |
| `delay` | `numberOrString` | `0` | Delay<br>Unit: `ms` |
| `easing` | `string` | `ease-in-out` | Easing<br>Options: `linear`, `ease`, `easeIn`, `easeOut`, `easeInOut`, `boing`, `urging`, `bouncing`, `decelerate`, `accelerate`, `smooth`, `sine`, `sineIn`, `sineOut`, `sineInOut`, `crisp`, `overshoot`, `runup`, `quartOut`, `velvet`, `gear`, `plateau` |
| `fill` | `string` | `backwards` | Fill mode<br>Options: `backwards`, `forwards`, `both`, `none` |
| `composite` | `string` | `accumulate` | Composition<br>Options: `accumulate`, `replace`, `add` |
| `direction` | `string` | `normal` | Direction<br>Options: `normal`, `reverse`, `alternate`, `alternate-reverse` |
| `iterations` | `number` | `1` | Iteration count |
| `keyframes` | `array` | Not supplied | Keyframes |

```javascript jaml-playground
export default {
    type: 'wrapper',
    styles: ['layout.flex(gap:1rem)'],
    components: [
        {
            type: 'label',
            cap: 'Pulse',
            onmount() {
                this.pulseAnimation = this.animate([{ opacity: 0.4 }, { opacity: 1 }], { duration: 600, delay: 0, iterations: Infinity, direction: 'alternate' });
            },
            onunmount() {
                this.pulseAnimation?.cancel();
            }
        }
    ]
};
```

## Easing names

| Name | Bézier | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `linear` | `(0, 0, 1, 1)` | Linear |
| `ease` | `(0.25, 0.1, 0.25, 1)` | Default CSS ease |
| `easeIn` | `(0.42, 0, 1, 1)` | Ease in |
| `easeOut` | `(0, 0, 0.58, 1)` | Ease out |
| `easeInOut` | `(0.42, 0, 0.58, 1)` | Ease in-out |
| `boing` | `(0.5, 0.5, 0.55, 1.68)` | Boing bounce |
| `urging` | `(0.23, 1, 0.32, 1)` | Urging |
| `bouncing` | `(0.44, 0.42, 0.16, 1.25)` | Bouncing |
| `decelerate` | `(0.23, 1, 0.32, 1)` | Decelerate |
| `accelerate` | `(0.55, 0.055, 0.675, 0.19)` | Accelerate |
| `smooth` | `(0.645, 0.045, 0.355, 1)` | Smooth |
| `sine` | `(0.445, 0.05, 0.55, 0.95)` | Sine |
| `sineIn` | `(0.47, 0, 0.745, 0.715)` | Sine in |
| `sineOut` | `(0.39, 0.575, 0.565, 1)` | Sine out |
| `sineInOut` | `(0.445, 0.05, 0.55, 0.95)` | Sine in-out |
| `crisp` | `(0.77, 0, 0.175, 1)` | Crisp transition |
| `overshoot` | `(0.68, -0.55, 0.265, 1.55)` | Overshoot and settle |
| `runup` | `(0.68, -0.55, 0.5, 0.5)` | Wind-up and go |
| `quartOut` | `(0.165, 0.84, 0.44, 1)` | Quart out |
| `velvet` | `(0.19, 1, 0.22, 1)` | Velvet smooth |
| `gear` | `(0.55, 0.085, 0.68, 0.53)` | Mechanical gear |
| `plateau` | `(0.25, 0.5, 0.75, 0.5)` | Flat plateau |

Presets also accept CSS `cubic-bezier(...)`, `linear(...)` and `steps(n, position)` strings. Their declared easing type is string; do not pass a raw array.

## Entry animations

Use an entry transition for newly shown content.

Load the framework animation styles. The shared animation builder skips direct entry/exit CSS-variable setup for popup elements; do not assume these styles replace popup show/hide configuration.

Registers entry animation settings and applies them immediately to an already connected non-popup host; framework append/show handling uses the same settings later. Updating text on the same host does not replay entry; remounting or framework re-entry can. The application owns message identity and new-message eligibility.

Combine an entry style and an exit style on the same host. Use animation.flipchild on its parent when surrounding children must animate their changed positions.

The timing helpers accept random(...) and seq(...) expressions; seq timing uses the animation index. A custom beforeApply replaces variant preparation, so preserve any needed origin, scale or perspective setup.

Entry presets run on append/show and can be paired with an exit preset.

Entry presets do not supply a generic reduced-motion policy. For message fades, use the native fade preset with a scoped prefers-reduced-motion stylesheet that sets animation-duration to 1ms and animation-delay to zero and opacity to the configured final value, as shown in the fade example. The finite duration keeps native animation events while immediate final opacity suppresses visible motion. A zero duration may skip those events on initial insertion. Do not use only `animation: none`: entry preparation waits for animation events to clear pending opacity. Prefer `duration:var(--jam-motion-fast)` for theme timing. Apply fades only to newly arriving messages, not every history restoration. Native entry does not provide an abortable per-message handle; do not treat detached-row cleanup or asynchronous beforeApply cancellation as guaranteed.

## Exit animations

Use an exit transition for content being hidden or removed.

Load the framework animation styles. The shared animation builder skips direct entry/exit CSS-variable setup for popup elements; do not assume these styles replace popup show/hide configuration.

Registers exit animation settings for framework animated removal or hiding; applying the style alone does not remove or hide the host.

Combine an entry style and an exit style on the same host. Use animation.flipchild on its parent when surrounding children must animate their changed positions.

The timing helpers accept random(...) and seq(...) expressions; seq timing uses the animation index. A custom beforeApply replaces variant preparation, so preserve any needed origin, scale or perspective setup.

Exit presets run on framework animated hide/removal. Applying a preset alone does not hide or remove the host. Direction defaults differ by variant; consult the overrides below.

### `animation.exit.fadeout`

<a id="entry-animation-exit-fadeout"></a>

Fade out

Fade an element from its configured opacity to transparent.

Positional order: `duration` → `easing` → `delay` → `fill` → `origin` → `triggerSelector` → `beforeApply` → `direction`.

Common arguments: [animation.entry.fadein](#common-animation-args).

```javascript jaml-playground
export default {
    type: 'wrapper',
    styles: ['layout.flex(gap:1rem)'],
    components: [{ type: 'label', cap: 'fadeout — close me', styles: ['animation.exit.fadeout(duration:600)', 'interact.closable'] }]
};
```

### `animation.exit.disappear`

<a id="entry-animation-exit-disappear"></a>

Disappear

Positional order: `duration` → `easing` → `delay` → `fill` → `origin` → `triggerSelector` → `beforeApply` → `direction`.

Common arguments: [animation.entry.fadein](#common-animation-args).

| `beforeApply` | `function` | Runtime-determined (function) | Callback before applying<br>Receives (el, args). Replacing it also replaces variant preparation for scale and origin. |
| `direction` | `string` | `reverse` | Direction |

<a id="entry-animation-exit-squeeze"></a>

Squeeze exit

Fold an element along one axis toward the chosen edge or center.

Positional order: `duration` → `easing` → `delay` → `fill` → `origin` → `triggerSelector` → `beforeApply` → `direction` → `to`.

Common arguments: [animation.entry.fadein](#common-animation-args).

Additions and overrides:

| Argument | Type | Default | Contract |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `beforeApply` | `function` | Runtime-determined (function) | Callback before applying<br>Receives (el, args). Replacing it also replaces variant preparation for scale and origin. |
| `direction` | `string` | `reverse` | Direction |
| `to` | `string` | `center` | End<br>Options: `top`, `left`, `bottom`, `right`, `center`, `middle` |

```javascript jaml-playground
export default {
    type: 'wrapper',
    styles: ['layout.flex(gap:1rem)'],
    components: [{ type: 'label', cap: 'squeeze — close me', styles: ['animation.exit.squeeze(duration:600)', 'interact.closable'] }]
};
```

## `animation.flipchild`

<a id="entry-animation-flipchild"></a>

FLIP animation for child positions

Animate sibling reflow after children are added, removed, shown or hidden.

Captures visible in-flow HTMLElement children in CSS order before a configured child event, then animates their changed positions after the paired event. Popup triggers are ignored; seq delays can spread from a captured reference child. Repeated layout changes retarget active FLIP motion.

Apply to the parent whose children emit the configured before/after child events. Arbitrary DOM changes without those events do not trigger this style.

Registers before/after event listeners; teardown removes those listeners and the style data.

Combine with child entry/exit styles so appearing content and moving peers have separate animation responsibilities.

Display-none, absolute and fixed children are excluded from the captured layout items. This style responds to event pairs rather than observing every layout mutation.

Positional order: `duration` → `easing` → `delay` → `fill` → `origin` → `triggerSelector` → `beforeApply` → `direction` → `beforeEvents` → `afterEvents` → `additionalBeforeEvents` → `additionalAfterEvents`.

| Argument | Type | Default | Contract |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `duration` | `number` | `200` | Duration |
| `easing` | `string` | `ease-in-out` | Easing<br>Options: `linear`, `ease`, `easeIn`, `easeOut`, `easeInOut`, `boing`, `urging`, `bouncing`, `decelerate`, `accelerate`, `smooth`, `sine`, `sineIn`, `sineOut`, `sineInOut`, `crisp`, `overshoot`, `runup`, `quartOut`, `velvet`, `gear`, `plateau` |
| `delay` | `numberOrString` | `0` | Delay |
| `fill` | `string` | `backwards` | Fill mode<br>Options: `backwards`, `forwards`, `both`, `none` |
| `origin` | `string` | Not supplied | Origin |
| `triggerSelector` | `string` | Not supplied | Trigger selector |
| `beforeApply` | `function` | Not supplied | Callback before applying |
| `direction` | `string` | `normal` | Direction |
| `beforeEvents` | `array` | `["beforechildremove","beforechildhide","beforechildshow","beforechildadd"]` | before event |
| `afterEvents` | `array` | `["childremoving","childhiding","childshow","childadded"]` | after event |
| `additionalBeforeEvents` | `array` | `[]` | Additional before events |
| `additionalAfterEvents` | `array` | `[]` | Additional after events |

```javascript jaml-playground
export default [
    {
        type: 'container',
        styles: ['layout.flex(gap:1rem)', 'animation.flipchild(duration:600)'],
        components: [
            { type: 'label', cap: 'Close child 1', styles: ['interact.closable', 'animation.exit.fadeout(duration:200)'] },
            { type: 'label', cap: 'Close child 2', styles: ['interact.closable', 'animation.exit.fadeout(duration:200)'] },
            { type: 'label', cap: 'Close child 3', styles: ['interact.closable', 'animation.exit.fadeout(duration:200)'] }
        ]
    }
];
```

## `animation.intersectionBlocker`

<a id="entry-animation-intersectionblocker"></a>

Intersection observer blocker

Delay a child entry animation until its first observed intersection within the configured observation root.

Observes matching targets in each child subtree and blocks entry on their showing readiness promise. Hiding before first appearance cancels the pending showing callback and makes the next attempt wait briefly.

Use framework elements exposing onReady and trigger as matched targets, with IntersectionObserver available. target selects within each child; the default :scope targets that child itself.

Removed targets are unobserved and their entry blockers are removed. Style teardown disconnects its intersection and child observers.

Apply to a parent and give its targets an animation.entry style. The styled parent is the observation root by default; set option.root to null to observe against the browser viewport.

This gates the first showing event; it is not a repeated scroll-reveal animation. The child filter controls observed mutations, so keep the initial children and target matches compatible with framework readiness methods. Initial children bypass the mutation filter.

Positional order: `filter` → `option` → `target`.

| Argument | Type | Default | Contract |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `filter` | `function` | Runtime-determined (function) | Node filter |
| `option` | `dictionary` | Not supplied | IntersectionObserver options |
| `target` | `string` | `:scope` | Target element<br>Shorthand |

```javascript jaml-playground
export default {
    type: 'wrapper',
    styles: ['animation.intersectionBlocker'],
    components: [{ type: 'label', cap: 'Observed child', styles: ['animation.entry.frombottom'] }]
};
```

## Usage

Combine entry and exit styles on the same host; use `animation.flipchild` on the parent to animate sibling movement. Entry runs when content is appended or shown. Exit requires framework animated hide/removal; the close controls in these examples trigger it.

```javascript jaml-playground
export default {
    type: 'wrapper',
    styles: ['layout.flex(gap:1rem)'],
    components: [
        {
            type: 'container',
            styles: ['animation.entry.frombottom(delay:seq(30);duration:400)'],
            components: [{ type: 'label', cap: 'Animated entry' }]
        }
    ]
};
```

## FLIP animation

Close a card to see its exit transition and the remaining cards move into place. Add a card to see entry and sibling reflow. The example starts with 12 cards and imports its card factory from the delivered Wiki assets, so it runs in this Wiki and the Playground. FLIP responds to its configured before/after event pairs, rather than arbitrary DOM mutations.

```javascript jaml-playground
export default {
    type: 'wrapper',
    styles: ['layout.flex(direction:column;gap:1rem)'],
    components: [
        {
            type: 'button',
            cap: 'Add animated card',
            async onclick() {
                const { card } = await import(new URL(rambutan.resolvePath('wiki/pages/Styles/examples/animation/cards.mjs'), location.href).href);
                const _host = this.nextElementSibling;
                if (!_host?.isConnected) {
                    return;
                }
                _host.cardCount = (_host.cardCount ?? 0) + 1;
                _host.appendChild(jame(card(_host.cardCount)));
            }
        },
        {
            type: 'wrapper',
            id: 'animation-example-cards',
            styles: ['layout.autogrid(repeat:4)', 'css(position:relative;gap:1rem)', 'animation.flipchild(duration:400;fill:backwards;easing:ease;delay:seq(20))'],
            async onmount() {
                const { card } = await import(new URL(rambutan.resolvePath('wiki/pages/Styles/examples/animation/cards.mjs'), location.href).href);
                if (!this.isConnected || this.cardsInitialized) {
                    return;
                }
                this.cardsInitialized = true;
                for (let index = 0; index < 12; index++) {
                    this.cardCount = (this.cardCount ?? 0) + 1;
                    this.appendChild(jame(card(this.cardCount)));
                }
            }
        }
    ]
};
```

## Built-in popup keyframes

Dropdown popup configuration uses the following keyframes. Placement resolves `DIR_Y` in strings such as `expand-DIR_Y 300ms ease-out` from the popup's position relative to its target. Popup configuration owns these transitions; entry/exit presets do not replace it.

| Keyframe | Trigger | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `expand-bottom` | Show | Fade in, slide down and scale Y from 0.75, with the origin at the top. |
| `collapse-bottom` | Hide | Fade out, slide up and scale Y to 0.75, with the origin at the top. |
| `expand-top` | Show | Fade in, slide up and scale Y from 0.75, with the origin at the bottom. |
| `collapse-top` | Hide | Fade out, slide down and scale Y to 0.75, with the origin at the bottom. |

These animate `opacity` and `transform`. Directional slide distance/scale and FLIP event arguments are documented beside their entries above.
